name: Kiss Me Through The Screen
source:
Your childhood best friend has been bothering you about joining a server he has with his friends for weeks now. What do you have to lose? It's summer--you have all the time in the world.

[From [url=https://nibbitnoot.itch.io/kiss-me-through-the-screen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
连续好几个星期以来，你青梅竹马的死党一直缠着你加入他和朋友们建的聊天服务器。反正也没什么损失，对吧？现在正值暑假——你最不缺的就是大把时间。

[摘自[url=https://nibbitnoot.itch.io/kiss-me-through-the-screen]itch.io[/url]]
